notes:
Inbound SMB signup via self-serve. Product manager (Samir Patel) did quick POC on hosted API and came back with lots of 'which model should we use?' questions. Wants a lightweight decision matrix rather than full eval. Key context:
- Primary workload: customer support chat + compressed transcript summarization for tickets and weekly digest. Secondary: short FAQ/knowledge retrieval (embeddings planned later).
- Traffic profile: currently ~200 chats/day, peak concurrent users ~10. Target latency: ~ <300ms for token streaming; acceptable up to 500ms for initial MVP. Cost sensitive: target <$0.05 per chat (end-to-end tokens).
- Tried self-serve: hit rate limits when trying 3 variants in parallel, unclear which Llama/Mistral/Qwen sizes to pick. Asked specifically about Llama 2/3 variants vs Mistral 7B Instruct vs Qwen-7B/14B cost/quality tradeoffs.
- Security: public cloud OK; want SSO (SAML) + audit logs. No on-prem requirement now. Data retention policy: keep chat logs 90 days, need ability to purge on request.
- Quote from Samir: "We want something that doesn't blow our budget but also isn't constantly hallucinating on product config answers."
- Current blockers: no clear cost per convo estimate, internal budget window closes mid-April, engineering bandwidth limited to 2 sprint's worth for integration.
